scope: Top 30 absolute mismatches from the 3,725-target re-issue fidelity harness. This is not the 3,780-target December mismatch audit and must not be pooled with it.
interpretation: Every top mismatch is a later re-issue whose reconstructed target identity differed from the live id at the original cutoff.
